name: og
description: Per-URL Open Graph / Twitter meta for link previews: the SPA shell's <head> is rewritten for crawlers by the server (Node and Cloudflare Pages alike)

env.description: Public origin of the site (https://app.example.com) used in og:url / canonical / og:image. Set it on every deployed instance: empty = those tags are left out (the request host is never believed)

next: set NUXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL on every deployed instance — without it link previews carry no og:url / canonical / site-relative image
